We started trading in 1999 as GJB plumbing and Property Maintenance, then, in 2010 GJB registered as a Limited Company. The GJB team believe in the ethos of the company and have built their business on delivering excellent customer service with the dedication and commitment of the GJB Team.  We have been very successful in our 17 years of trading, covering the whole of Leeds, Wakefield and Bradford.
These statements are our beliefs and part of every working day.

We are dedicated to getting the job done quickly and right the first time. You won’t be faced with surprise bills, GJB Plumbing give their customers a realistic and fair estimate before any works begin. GJB Plumbing prides itself on cleanliness and safety. Our team are friendly, respectful and committed to making customers feel at ease during any plumbing or maintenance works being carried.
